verdict.rationale: TruffleHog's own docs describe a custom regex detector for defining organization-specific detectors with regular expressions. It also offers optional verification through a webhook POST to a user-provided endpoint, which directly covers internal token and secret formats. missing for 10: detailed evidence of the custom detector configuration schema (keywords, multi-part patterns, entropy/filter options), independent or hands-on corroboration of custom rules in practice.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can define custom detection rules for my organization's internal token and secret formats

citations.quote: The custom regex detector allows you to define your own detector using regular expressions with optional verification using a webhook.
Verification is done via a webhook POST request to the provided `endpoint`.
